transition.purpose: evidence-bounded continuity decision, not universal equivalence certification

decision_states.scientific_fail_rule: FAIL is permitted only when complete, valid, replayable source and target evidence demonstrates an operational-tolerance violation.

source_baseline.preprocessing_semantics: frozen by the source teacher manifest

measurement_null.evidence_strength: preliminary empirical source envelope; not a probabilistic prediction interval

data_roles.measurement_null: estimates source measurement resolution only; never promotes a candidate
data_roles.quantization_calibration: reserved for transition B calibration and prohibited from transition A tolerance selection
data_roles.contract_development: diagnostic development role; cannot tune a frozen contract after target evidence exists
data_roles.validation: pre-promotion evaluation after the contract is frozen
data_roles.frozen_critical: blocking regression role with zero tolerance for declared quality and ranking regressions
data_roles.final_holdout: single final decision role; excluded from threshold selection and all iterative target changes

detection_limits.application: A difference no larger than these empirical limits is not distinguishable from the observed CPU source variation. These limits do not set material acceptance.

selection_basis.rationale: The limits protect retrieval semantics while allowing numerically normal FP32 interchange differences. They are frozen before any ONNX export and may change only in a new contract version.

system_metrics.reason: The contract does not claim a portable performance baseline across hardware.

decision_policy.PASS: All required replayable evidence is present, target execution is valid, and every applicable operational tolerance is satisfied.
decision_policy.FAIL: Valid replayable evidence shows one or more applicable operational tolerances exceeded.
decision_policy.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is complete but uncertainty or an interval intersects an operational boundary without a justified PASS or FAIL.
decision_policy.BLOCKED: A declared artifact, observation, prerequisite, or replay requirement is missing or fails integrity verification.
decision_policy.EXECUTION_ERROR: Export, ONNX runtime, provider, preprocessing, or output execution fails. This is not a scientific regression.

replay_policy.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 tamper-evident manifests; artifacts are not claimed physically immutable
